messages.content: Please recheck the Westin partial ocean-view king and the Seafarer one-bedroom king suite for August 22 through 28. I want the full charges and reservation terms one more time, then we can book one.

Both rooms are still available for six nights and two adults. The Westin partial ocean-view king is $2,065.68 total: $1,608.00 room charge, $240.00 mandatory destination charge, and $217.68 estimated taxes. Self-parking is included in that rate, so there is no separate parking charge. A $344.28 deposit is charged when booked, with the balance due at the hotel. Cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. local time on August 18; after that, the deposit is forfeited.

The Seafarer one-bedroom king suite is $1,471.68 total: $1,314.00 room charge and $157.68 estimated taxes. Parking is included, and there is no mandatory resort fee. A $245.28 deposit is charged when booked, with the balance due at the property. Cancellation is free through 4:00 p.m. local time on August 20; after that, the deposit is forfeited.
And the beach routes have not changed?

Correct. The Westin has an ocean-side boardwalk directly from the property to the beach, with no public-road crossing. At Seafarer, you cross two-lane North Beachview Drive at the marked crossing and continue along the public dune path; it is roughly a two-to-four-minute walk to the sand.
The Seafarer room is still the larger setup with the separate sitting room and kitchenette, right? Not just a standard king labeled as a suite.

Yes. The available Seafarer room is specifically the one-bedroom king suite, with a bedroom separated from the sitting area and a kitchenette. The Westin room is a standard partial ocean-view king in the main building, not a suite.
Yes. The Westin total of $2,065.68 is $594.00 more than the Seafarer total of $1,471.68.
We talked it over. Book the Westin. We would rather have direct access and be next to Beach Village, even with the smaller room.
I can place that reservation. Before I submit it, please confirm the primary guest name, the second guest, and whether I should use the saved card ending in 1842 for the $344.28 deposit.
Primary guest Avery Thompson, second guest Morgan Thompson. Use the card ending in 1842. Please make sure it is the partial ocean-view king and not the traditional king.

Confirmed: Westin Jekyll Island Beach Resort, partial ocean-view king in the main building, August 22 check-in and August 28 check-out, two adults, with Avery Thompson as primary guest and Morgan Thompson as the second guest. The total is $2,065.68, and the card ending in 1842 will be charged the $344.28 deposit. Shall I submit it?

The reservation is confirmed. The $344.28 deposit was charged to the card ending in 1842, and the remaining $1,721.40 is due at the hotel. The booking is for a partial ocean-view king in the main building for Avery and Morgan Thompson, August 22 through 28. The complete estimated lodging total is $2,065.68, including the mandatory destination charge, self-parking, and estimated taxes.
Give me the confirmation number and put the cancellation cutoff in plain terms so I do not misread it later.

Confirmation number: WJI-8247316. You may cancel without penalty until 11:59 p.m. Jekyll Island local time on August 18. Beginning at 12:00 a.m. on August 19, the $344.28 deposit becomes nonrefundable. The Seafarer was not booked, and no other coastal reservation was created.
